name: Uncovering Past Secrets
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Anyway, you should check back with me relatively soon... that is if you want to know what was in here.  As soon as I find out what it is, and if it's indeed a book, I'd be happy to share that information with you.

In the meantime, I'd check in with the den mother of this little bear camp, Rabine.  No doubt he'll want to know what crazy antics you've been up to.  Never leave the den mother waiting, adventurer... that is, unless you want to be doused in honey.

It's happened, trust me.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, adventurer - I had hoped you would stop by. I am glad to see you well.

I received notice you would be coming in from the field, and I wanted to personally express the Cenarion Circle's gratitude for the assistance you've given us thus far. No doubt there are more secrets to uncover from Silithus; your delivery to Umber should prove most interesting once uncovered. Please, accept this as a token of our continued appreciation for your aid.

Thank you, generous Champion.
